entries.2a5ce246421136fb: A reporting segment that sells amusement equipment such as arcade game machines, as well as used equipment, sticker printing paper, parts and prizes. Its sales base is in Tokyo, and it also provides advice and proposals based on machine operating data and operating know-how obtained from store operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350 million.
entries.472eedca88a9f076: Purchasers of toys and miscellaneous goods
entries.47c02a12ce890dcb: A reporting segment that operates amusement arcades centered on the game center “Apina,” as well as batting centers, bowling alleys and others. The business is centered on Nagano Prefecture and has expanded across Japan, and the number of stores as of March 31, 2026 was 73. It mainly consists of prize games, video games and medal games, and also conducts “managed placement,” in which machines are leased in spaces at shopping centers and hot spring facilities and management is entrusted to the facility owners. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,968 million.
entries.8db8e604e2121e1d: A company that operates amusement facilities such as "Apina" nationwide and also sells amusement machines.
entries.a1a6cb6f691ed210: Not included in reporting segments. It conducts an advertising agency business using media such as flyers and television commercials, a trading card business that sells and buys back new and used trading cards, and planning, development and sales of toys and miscellaneous goods centered on “squeeze” products through consolidated subsidiary Bloom Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,410 million.
